shortDescription: Calls the FICS Mortgage Servicer special services API to generate a document containing the Amortized Loan Statements

options.name: api_log_directory
options.description: this is the directory that the API logs will be created in

options.name: api_token
options.description: this is the api token used for authentication to the API

options.name: api_update
options.description: this is a bool that will confirm whether the database is updated

options.name: dest
options.description: This is the full path to where the file will be created, it creates parent directories if they do not exist

options.name: fics_api_url
options.description: This is the URL of the special service API
